## About
Fleet Masters Truck and Trailer Repair is a full-service truck and trailer repair shop in Medley. We handle roadside assistance, in-shop repairs, tire repair, truck repairs and trailer repairs.
We're a team of hard-working mechanics who specialize in diesel vehicles. We keep spare parts from well-known brands on hand, so you're not stuck waiting on parts.
Drivers rate us 4.7 from 341 Google reviews. Call us any hour, or get in touch for a free quotation.

## Services
- 24/7 Emergency Roadside: Flat tires, dead batteries, lockouts and more, any time of day or night.
- Towing Services: Light duty, medium duty and heavy duty towing for vehicles of all sizes.
- In-shop repairs: Bring your truck or trailer into our Medley shop for repair and maintenance.
- Tire repair: Tire repair for trucks and trailers.
- Truck and trailer repairs: Professional heavy vehicle repair and maintenance for trucks and trailers of different makes and models.
- Dive Recovery
- Hazmat cleanup

## FAQ
Q: Can I call you in the middle of the night?
A: Yes. Our team is available round-the-clock, so call whenever you need help.

Q: What roadside problems can you handle?
A: Flat tires, dead batteries, lockouts and more. We aim to get to you promptly and get you back on the road.

Q: Do you give quotes?
A: Yes. Get in touch with us for a free quotation.

Q: How fast do you answer email?
A: Please allow up to 24-48 hours for an email reply. If it can't wait, call us.

Q: Do you work outside Miami?
A: We list locations in Miami, Tampa and Jacksonville, plus a nationwide network.
